Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 A number;
BEGIN
 
default_value('0','GLOBAL.rec_no') ;
:donors.no := to_number(:GLOBAL.rec_no) + 1;
:GLOBAL.rec_no := :donors.no;
:donors.TOTAL_DONATIONS := 
 CAL_DON(:donors.donor_id, :ctrl_block.end_date) + CAL_CLAIMED(:donors.donor_id);
--message(:donors.donor_id || ' ' || to_char(:donors.coll_date));
BEGIN
 SELECT initcap(last_name)||', '||initcap(first_name ) don_name, 
 gender, date_of_birth, unit_id 
 INTO :donors.donor_name, 
 :donors.gender,
 :donors.date_of_birth, :donors.last_unit_id
 FROM donors, donations
 WHERE donors.donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 AND donors.donor_id = donations.donor_id
 AND donations.coll_date = :donors.coll_date
 --AND donors.chapter_id = 'ALL'
 and decode(donors.chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, donors.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 AND donations.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND unit_id is not null
 AND rownum = 1;
 :donors.last_donation_date := :donors.coll_date;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN 
 :donors.donor_name := :donors.donor_id;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END; 



if :donors.print_flag = 'N' then
 :global.gen_flag := 'E';
elsif :donors.print_flag = 'Y' then
 :global.prn_flag := 'E';
end if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SELECT_DONORS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE select_donors IS
 --CURSOR for FIRST TIME DONOR
 cursor c1(fdate date,tdate date) is
 SELECT B.DONOR_ID, D.COLL_DATE 
 FROM DONATIONS D,DONORS B
 WHERE d.unit_id is not null and COLL_DATE BETWEEN fdate AND tdate
 AND 1= (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DONATIONS
 WHERE DONOR_ID=D.DONOR_ID 
 AND donation_type = 'AL'
 AND unit_id is not null)
 AND D.DONOR_ID = B.DONOR_ID
 AND d.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 ORDER by d.coll_date desc, b.last_name;
 --CURSOR for Gallon Donor
 cursor c2(fdate date,tdate date) is
 SELECT B.DONOR_ID, D.COLL_DATE
 FROM DONATIONS D,DONORS B
 WHERE d.unit_id is not null and COLL_DATE BETWEEN fdate AND tdate
 AND D.DONOR_ID=B.DONOR_ID and d.donation_type = 'AL'
 AND d.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 order by d.coll_date desc, b.last_name;
 don C1%ROWTYPE;
 gal C2%ROWTYPE;
 where_c varchar2(500);
 ret_val varchar2(5);
 temp number;
 gallon number;
 doncnt number;
 du_temp number;
 don_tot_gal number;
 edate date := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_block.end_date,'MM-DD-RR') || ' 23:59','MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'); 
BEGIN
 :ctrl_block.end_date := edate;
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'BUSY');
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 go_block('donors');
 set_block_property('donors', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('donors', delete_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('donors', update_allowed, property_true);
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :global.gen_flag := 'D';
 :global.prn_flag := 'D';
 if :ctrl_block.search_type = 'FirstTimeFixed' then
 FOR don IN c1(trunc(:start_date), :end_date)
 LOOP
 begin
 select insert_date
 into :donors.insert_date
 from donor_label_print_file
 where donor_id = don.donor_id
 and coll_date between :start_date and :end_date
 and comm_code = 'FRTTM'; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 insert into donor_label_print_file
 (donor_id, coll_date, comm_code,
 gallons, print_flag, insert_date,
 insert_user, program_id, chapter_id)
 values( don.donor_id, don.COLL_DATE, 'FRTTM',
 0, 'N', sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name, :global.chapter_id);
 when others then 
 :donors.insert_date := sysdate; 
 end;
 end loop;
 where_c := ' COMM_CODE = ''FRTTM'' and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and COLL_DATE between :start_date and :end_date';
 else
 FOR gal IN c2(trunc(:start_date), :end_date)
 LOOP
 ret_val := calculate_donations(gal.donor_id);
 IF ret_val != 'FALSE' THEN 
 begin
 select insert_date 
 into :donors.insert_date
 from donor_label_print_file
 where donor_id = gal.donor_id
 and coll_date between :start_date and :end_date
 and gallons = decode(ret_val,'TRUE',:ctrl_block.gallans,ret_val)
 and rownum = 1; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 insert into donor_label_print_file
 (donor_id, coll_date, comm_code,
 gallons, print_flag, insert_date,
 insert_user, program_id,
 chapter_id) -- Added by Kishore on 01/16/2015. IM 10330
 values
 ( gal.donor_id, gal.COLL_DATE, 'GAL'||decode(ret_val,'TRUE',:ctrl_block.gallans,ret_val),
 decode(ret_val,'TRUE',:ctrl_block.gallans,ret_val), 'N', sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name,
 :global.chapter_id); -- Added by Kishore on 01/16/2015. IM 10330
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 end;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF :ctrl_block.gallans is null THEN 
 where_c := 'COMM_CODE like ''GAL%'' and COLL_DATE between :start_date and :end_date' ||
 ' and nvl(gallons,0) > 0 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ';
 ELSE
 where_c := 'COMM_CODE = ''GAL' || :ctrl_block.gallans ||

ProgramUnit.Name: CALCULATE_DONATIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION Calculate_Donations(p_donor_id IN donors.donor_id%type)
RETURN varchar2 IS
 pre_credit_count number(10);
 tot_credit_count number(10);
 cl_don number(10);
 v_sysdate date; -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 t_gal_param valid_parameters.parameter_value%type; -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 BEGIN
 pre_credit_count := CAL_DON(p_donor_id, :ctrl_block.start_date - (1/1440)); -- 24 hrs * 60 minutes = 1440 minutes in a day
 tot_credit_count := CAL_DON(p_donor_id, :ctrl_block.end_date);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 cl_don := CAL_CLAIMED(p_donor_id);
 --message(p_donor_id || ' ' || to_char(tot_credit_count) || ' ' || to_char(pre_credit_count)); 
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 begin
 select parameter_value 
 into t_gal_param
 from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'GALLON_VAL' 
 and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('3121');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- End of change
 
 --IF floor((tot_credit_count + cl_don)/8) > floor((pre_credit_count + cl_don)/8) THEN -- Commented by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 if floor((tot_credit_count + cl_don)/t_gal_param) > floor((pre_credit_count + cl_don)/t_gal_param) then -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 IF :ctrl_block.gallans is not null THEN
 --IF floor((tot_credit_count + cl_don)/8) = :ctrl_block.gallans THEN -- Commented by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21290
 if floor((tot_credit_count + cl_don)/t_gal_param) = :ctrl_block.gallans then -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 return 'TRUE';
 ELSE
 return 'FALSE';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 --return floor((tot_credit_count + cl_don)/8); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 return floor((tot_credit_count + cl_don)/t_gal_param); -- Added by Kishore on 04/10/2015. SCR 21371
 END IF;
 ELSE
 return 'FALSE';
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAL_DON
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION cal_don(p_don_id in varchar2, p_date in date) RETURN number IS
 temp_c_count number := 0; 
BEGIN
 select nvl(sum(donations.credit_count),0)
 into temp_c_count
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_don_id
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --MS
 and unit_id is not null
 and coll_date <= p_date
 and donation_type = 'AL'
 group by donor_id;
 return temp_c_count;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 return 0;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAL_CLAIMED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CAL_CLAIMED(p_donor_id in varchar2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 cl_don number(5);
BEGIN
 select nvl(donors.claimed_donation, 0)
 into cl_don
 from donors
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 --and chapter_id = 'ALL';
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id; --MS

 return cl_don;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 return 0;--handle_error; 
END;

 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 
 check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is null and 
 :system.trigger_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('11067');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.start_date > trunc(v_sysdate) then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('18014');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.end_date >= trunc( to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') + 1 ) then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('18014');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('11065');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;


exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('9191');
 raise form_trigger_failure;

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 go_block('donors');
 first_record;
 loop
 update donor_label_print_file set print_flag = :donors.print_flag
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 and coll_date = :donors.last_donation_date;

 if :donors.print_flag = 'Y' then
 update donor_communications set action_code=NULL,
 action_date =NULL
 where donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 and com_code='FRTTM'
 and com_type='DCORR';
 end if;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 show_error('9163');
 check_package_failure;

 :system.message_level := 0;
 change_print_flag;
 first_record;
end;
